question: 지난주 라인별 생산량과 검사 불량률을 같이 보여줘
sql:
SELECT 
    l.line_id, 
    l.line_name, 
    SUM(p.good_qty) AS total_good_qty, 
    SUM(p.scrap_qty) AS total_scrap_qty, 
    COUNT(i.insp_id) AS total_inspections, 
    SUM(i.defect_count) AS total_defects, 
    (SUM(i.defect_count) / COUNT(i.insp_id)) * 100 AS defect_rate

    lines l

    production_log p ON l.line_id = p.line_id AND p.ts >= '2026-09-21' AND p.ts <= '2026-09-27'
LEFT JOIN

question: 8월 라인별 생산량과 검사 불량률을 같이 보여줘
sql:
SELECT 
    l.line_name,
    SUM(p.good_qty) AS total_production,
    SUM(p.scrap_qty) AS total_scrap,
    SUM(p.scrap_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(p.good_qty) + SUM(p.scrap_qty), 0) * 100 AS scrap_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.insp_id) AS inspection_count,
    SUM(i.defect_count) AS total_defects,
    SUM(i.defect_count) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT i.insp_id), 0) * 100 AS defect_rate
FROM 
    production_log p
JOIN 
    work_orders w ON p.wo_id = w.wo_id
JOIN 
    lines l ON w.line_id = l.line_id
LEFT JOIN 
    inspections i ON p.ts >= i.ts AND p.ts < i.ts + INTERVAL '1 day'
WHERE 
    p.ts BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY 
    l.line_name
ORDER BY 
    l.line_name

SELECT 
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN w.start_ts >= '2026-09-01' AND w.start_ts <= '2026-09-15' THEN w.planned_qty ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
      SUM(CASE WHEN w.start_ts >= '2026-09-01' AND w.start_ts <= '2026-09-15' THEN w.planned_qty ELSE 0 END + 
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN dt.start_ts >= '2026-09-01' AND dt.start_ts <= '2026-09-15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100) AS line_utilization

    work_orders w
JOIN 
    equipment e ON w.line_id = e.line_id
LEFT JOIN 
    downtime dt ON e.eq_id = dt.eq_id AND dt.start_ts >= '2026-09-01' AND dt.start_ts <= '2026-09-15'
WHERE 
    w.line_id = '1'

question: 지난주 3라인 가동률은?

SELECT 
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN w.shift = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 24 * 60 * 60) / 
     (SUM((d.end_ts - d.start_ts) * (d.planned::int))) * 100) AS weekly_production_rate
FROM 
    work_orders w
JOIN 
    production_log p ON w.wo_id = p.wo_id
JOIN 
    downtime d ON w.wo_id = d.wo_id

    w.line_id = '3' AND

question: 지난주 1라인 검사 중 FAIL 판정 비율은?
